image_handling_rules.overlay: Use bg-gradient-to-t from-[#1A3626]/60 to-transparent for text contrast over category images.

attributes: All list items must have data-testid='list-item-[id]'
Price comparison triggers must have data-testid='compare-prices-[item-id]'

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. DO NOT USE DEFAULT TAILWIND BLUE, GRAY, OR PURPLE.
Implement the UI for React using Tailwind CSS and raw HTML where Shadcn components are too restrictive. Only use Shadcn for complex interactions like Dialogs or Dropdowns.
For the main Shopping List view, use an asymmetrical bento grid on Desktop, but a clean list view on mobile. The list items must have Generous padding (p-4 or p-6).

When a user selects an item, the Price Comparison view should open in a Glassmorphism Drawer or Modal, using the 'Control Room Grid' layout (dense, edge-to-edge data) for comparing Amazon Fresh, Blinkit, etc.
Apply 'Electric Tangerine' (#FF6B35) strictly for marking the 'Best Deal' or highlighting savings.
Ensure the layout is highly responsive. The Bottom Navigation must be sticky on mobile, but transformed into a left sidebar on Desktop.
Use @phosphor-icons/react for icons to match the tactile, organic feel (Duotone weight preferred).
Use Work Sans for all body text and Cabinet Grotesk for Headings. Enforce tracking-tight on all Headings.
For the MVP, mock the price data from the 6 platforms, but make the UI look like real production data with proper loading states (skeleton screens using the secondary background color).
DO NOT use placeholder image URLs. Use the exact URLs provided in the media section of this JSON.
